stem: Which of the following factors directly affects the moment of inertia of a particle? (a) Force applied (b) Shape of the object (c) Perpendicular distance from the axis (d) Time —

stem: If all particles in a system are closer to the axis, the moment of inertia will: (a) Increase (b) Decrease (c) Stay the same (d) Become zero —
